plugins.name: hashicorp-deck
plugins.description: HashiCorp-branded presentation skills. `hashicorp-deck-html` builds single-file HTML5 scroll presentations in the HashiCorp brand style. `hashicorp-deck-htmltopptx` converts an existing HTML presentation into an editable .pptx re-typeset on the official HashiCorp CY26 kit: Inter, the signature glow gradient and HashiCorp's own slide layouts.

plugins.name: ibm-deck
plugins.description: IBM-branded presentation skills. `ibm-deck-htmltopptx` converts an existing HTML presentation into an editable .pptx re-typeset on the official IBM template: IBM Plex, the Carbon palette and IBM's own slide layouts.

plugins.name: hashicorp-diagram
plugins.description: HashiCorp-branded diagram assets. `hashicorp-diagram-excalidraw` supplies 54 Flight icons as an Excalidraw stencil scene and as individual SVGs, with every colour pinned to the Helios design system, for architecture diagrams drawn by hand in Excalidraw or Excalidraw+.

plugins.name: hashicorp-page
plugins.description: HashiCorp-branded document skills. `hashicorp-page-html` builds single-file HTML page documents — long-form reports, briefings, decision papers and leadership readouts: black top bar and hero with a headline-number strip, numbered sections, evidence tables, CSS-drawn charts and a provenance footer. A document, not a deck.

plugins.name: hashicorp-doc
plugins.description: HashiCorp-branded Word document skills. `hashicorp-doc-docx` builds a customer-facing .docx assessment or engagement report on the house template: full-bleed cover art with the wordmark, a live table of contents, a revision-history table, numbered sections under a `version / title` running header, and rule-and-band recommendation tables carrying ID / Impact / Effort / Priority / Category.
